```{r}
cat("\n")
cat(strrep("=", 79), "\n")
cat("EXAMPLE 1: MLP Diffusion on Swiss Roll with Train/Val/Test Split\n")
cat(strrep("=", 79), "\n")

# 1. 生成完整数据集

X_full <- swiss_roll(n = 2000, noise = 0.1, seed = 1)

# 2. 标准化（可逆）

Xmean <- colMeans(X_full)
Xsd   <- apply(X_full, 2, sd)
X_full_std <- scale(X_full, center = Xmean, scale = Xsd)

# 3. 数据划分：70% train, 15% val, 15% test

set.seed(42)
splits <- train_test_split(
X_full_std,
train_ratio = 0.7,
val_ratio   = 0.15,
seed        = 42
)

cat(sprintf("\n✓ Data split: train=%d, val=%d, test=%d\n",
nrow(splits$train), nrow(splits$val), nrow(splits$test)))
```

```{r}
# 4. 定义 schedule
sch <- beta_cosine(T = 1000)

# 5. 训练模型（仅在训练集上）
cat("\n--- Training MLP Diffusion Model ---\n")
fit_mlp <- train_diffusion_dist(
X          = splits$train,  # ✅ 只在训练集上训练
epochs     = 200,
T          = 1000,
lr         = 1e-4,
batch_size = 256,
schedule   = sch,
verbose    = TRUE,
seed       = 42
)
```


```{r}
cat("\n--- Sampling & Evaluating on Validation Set ---\n")

n_val_samples <- nrow(splits$val)
fake_val_std <- sample_ddpm(
fit   = fit_mlp,
n     = n_val_samples,
steps = fit_mlp$T,
seed  = 123
)

cat("\n--- Validation Set Metrics ---\n")
metrics_val <- evaluate_samples(
X_real  = splits$val,
X_fake  = fake_val_std,
type    = "distribution",
verbose = TRUE
)

metrics_val
```


```{r}
cat("\n--- Final Evaluation on Test Set ---\n")

n_test_samples <- nrow(splits$test)
fake_test_std <- sample_ddpm(
fit   = fit_mlp,
n     = n_test_samples,
steps = fit_mlp$T,
seed  = 456
)

metrics_test <- evaluate_samples(
X_real  = splits$test,
X_fake  = fake_test_std,
type    = "distribution",
verbose = TRUE
)

metrics_test
```



```{r}
metrics_summary <- data.frame(
split          = c("validation", "test"),
mmd            = c(metrics_val$mmd,            metrics_test$mmd),
frechet        = c(metrics_val$frechet,        metrics_test$frechet),
wasserstein_1d = c(metrics_val$wasserstein_1d, metrics_test$wasserstein_1d),
coverage       = c(metrics_val$coverage,       metrics_test$coverage),
density        = c(metrics_val$density,        metrics_test$density)
)

knitr::kable(metrics_summary, digits = 4, caption = "Distribution metrics on validation and test sets")

```



```{r}
# 9. 在训练集中采样一大批点，用于可视化

fake_full_std <- sample_ddpm(
fit   = fit_mlp,
n     = nrow(splits$train),
steps = fit_mlp$T,
seed  = 789
)

# ---- 还原到原坐标 ----

fake_full <- sweep(fake_full_std, 2, Xsd, `*`)
fake_full <- sweep(fake_full,     2, Xmean, `+`)
colnames(fake_full) <- c("x1", "x2")

# 🔹 按半径的 99% quantile 去除 outlier

fake_full_df <- as.data.frame(fake_full)

# 计算每个点到原点的距离

r <- sqrt(fake_full_df$x1^2 + fake_full_df$x2^2)

# 找到 99% 分位数阈值

r_thr <- quantile(r, 0.99)

# 只保留半径 <= 99% 分位数的点

fake_full_trim <- fake_full_df[r <= r_thr, ]

cat(sprintf("Removed %d outliers (top 1%% by radius)\n",
nrow(fake_full_df) - nrow(fake_full_trim)))

# ---- 还原训练集到原坐标 ----

X_train_orig <- sweep(splits$train, 2, Xsd, `*`)
X_train_orig <- sweep(X_train_orig, 2, Xmean, `+`)
colnames(X_train_orig) <- c("x1", "x2")

# 先准备两个数据框，加上标记列

df_real <- data.frame(
X_train_orig,
type  = "real",
panel = "Training data"
)

df_fake <- data.frame(
fake_full_trim,
type  = "fake",
panel = "Generated (99% trimmed)"
)

# 合在一起

df_all <- rbind(df_real, df_fake)

# 保证 facet 的顺序

df_all$panel <- factor(df_all$panel,
levels = c("Training data", "Generated (99% trimmed)"))

# 画图：一行两个 facet

p_all <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = x1, y = x2, color = type)) +
geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 0.6) +
coord_equal() +
facet_wrap(~ panel, nrow = 1) +
scale_color_manual(values = c("real" = "#00BFC4",
"fake" = "#F8766D")) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
theme(
legend.position = "right",
panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
) +
labs(
x     = "x1",
y     = "x2",
color = "type",
title = "Real vs Generated swiss roll (99% quantile trimmed)"
)

p_all

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 可视化：测试集真实数据 vs 生成样本（使用 test 评估时的那批样本）
# ============================================================

# 还原测试集到原坐标
X_test_orig <- sweep(splits$test, 2, Xsd, `*`)
X_test_orig <- sweep(X_test_orig, 2, Xmean, `+`)
colnames(X_test_orig) <- c("x1", "x2")

# 还原生成的测试样本到原坐标
fake_test <- sweep(fake_test_std, 2, Xsd, `*`)
fake_test <- sweep(fake_test,     2, Xmean, `+`)
colnames(fake_test) <- c("x1", "x2")

fake_test_df <- as.data.frame(fake_test)

# 🔹 按半径的 99% quantile 去除 outlier
r_test <- sqrt(fake_test_df$x1^2 + fake_test_df$x2^2)
r_thr_test <- quantile(r_test, 0.99)

fake_test_trim <- fake_test_df[r_test <= r_thr_test, ]

cat(sprintf("Test-vis: removed %d outliers (top 1%% by radius)\n",
            nrow(fake_test_df) - nrow(fake_test_trim)))

# 先准备两个数据框，加上标记列
df_real <- data.frame(
  X_test_orig,
  type  = "real",
  panel = "Test data"
)

df_fake <- data.frame(
  fake_test_trim,
  type  = "fake",
  panel = "Generated (99% trimmed)"
)

# 合在一起
df_all <- rbind(df_real, df_fake)

# 保证 facet 顺序
df_all$panel <- factor(df_all$panel,
                       levels = c("Test data", "Generated (99% trimmed)"))

# 画图：一行两个 facet
p_all <- ggplot(df_all, aes(x = x1, y = x2, color = type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 0.6) +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("real" = "#00BFC4",
                                "fake" = "#F8766D")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = "x1",
    y     = "x2",
    color = "type",
    title = "Test vs Generated swiss roll (99% quantile trimmed)"
  )

p_all
```
